description: A vibrant quilled apple tree in a white shadow-box frame. The lush canopy is built from layered paper coils in varied greens, scattered with red accents that read as fruit. A richly textured dark brown trunk anchors the piece against a clean white background.

A decorative hand-rolled paper bowl in a full rainbow palette. The interior features a concentric rainbow disc at the base, surrounded by densely packed pastel coils of varying sizes. A joyful, sculptural piece.
A circular wall clock with a quilled paper face in shades of blue and teal. The centre features a concentric spiral motif radiating outward into a ring of varied paper coils. Clean white hands.
A wall clock with a quilled paper face in warm earth tones - chocolate browns, soft creams, gold and black. The central spiral radiates outward through a ring of varied paper coils. Slim brass hands.

A playful children's wall clock with a quilled rainbow spiral face surrounded by colourful paper coils. The hour and minute hand are a coloured pencil and a small flower is the second hand. A bright, joyful design for a child's room or playroom.

A male Superb Fairywren beautifully rendered in quilled paper, perched on a textured brown branch with green foliage. The bird's distinctive electric blue cap and cheek patches contrast with deep navy on the back and breast, while warm tan and cream tones detail the wing and underside. The long blue tail rises elegantly above the body. Presented in a clean white shadow-box frame.

A triple-aperture white frame presenting three quilled Australian birds side by side: a Superb Fairywren in blue and chestnut, a Red-browed Finch with its distinctive red beak and eye-ring, and a Red-backed Fairywren in black with a vivid scarlet shoulder band. A study in native Australian songbirds.

Studio shot of three loose unframed bird figures (Red-backed Fairywren, Superb Fairywren, Red-browed Finch) held in hand. Useful as 'maker process' content but doesn't correspond to a specific saleable product. Recommend dropping unless reused as a generic 'about my work' image.

suggested_title: Pair of Fairywrens on Flowering Branch
description: A male Superb Fairywren and a female fairywren perched together on a flowering branch with delicate pink blossoms and green leaves. The male displays bold blue and chestnut plumage; the female is rendered in soft browns and creams with a coral beak and eye-ring. Presented in a deep white shadow-box frame.

suggested_title: Red-backed Fairywren and Finch on Wattle
description: A pair of Australian songbirds perched on a wattle branch: a male Red-backed Fairywren in black with a vibrant red shoulder band, and a Red-browed Finch with its distinctive red beak. The branch bursts with yellow wattle blossoms and green foliage. A celebration of native Australian flora and fauna in white shadow-box frame.

A striking Yellow-tailed Black Cockatoo rendered in quilled paper, perched on a branch with deep green foliage. The bird's distinctive yellow cheek patch and intricately scalloped black-and-yellow plumage are beautifully detailed. The long banded tail trails dramatically below. Presented in a clean white shadow-box frame.

A Yellow-tailed Black Cockatoo with softer grey-toned plumage and golden detailing, perched on a branch with paired green leaves. The yellow cheek patch and banded yellow tail remain prominent. A more muted variation of the cockatoo design, presented in a light oak frame with white matting.

suggested_title: Boho Rainbow, Sun and Clouds Triptych
description: A soft pastel nursery triptych in a single wide frame: an earth-toned rainbow on the left, a peachy sun with multicolour rays in the centre, and a peach cloud raining tiny multicolour hearts on the right. Warm, muted palette perfect for a modern nursery or child's room.

A scientifically-styled framed quilled paper rendering of the Australian native Blue Banded Bee (Amegilla cingulata), featuring detailed gold-bronze body work, translucent layered wings, and the species' distinctive electric blue abdominal stripes. Includes a scientific name plaque. A natural history specimen aesthetic in a deep black shadow-box frame.

A pair of black-and-white quilled cat portraits in matching black frames. Each shows a different kitten pose in a clean single-line silhouette style - one calm and seated, one playful with raised paw. Sold as a pair; perfect as a hallway grouping or for a cat-loving home.

A heart-shaped composition built entirely from tightly rolled pastel paper coils in a full rainbow spectrum. Shown here in two size options - a large square frame and a smaller version. A vibrant, joyful piece suitable as a feature wall artwork or a gift. See also P117 (Rainbow Hearts in a Heart) for a variant using dimensional quilled hearts instead of rolled coils.

A vibrant green praying mantis rendered in quilled paper with delicate striped detailing in green and warm brown. The classic raised-forelegs pose is captured precisely. Presented in a deep black shadow-box frame for a natural history specimen feel.

Studio photograph showing three separate products side by side: a black filigree-style sitting cat in a light oak frame, a handmade 'Love' greeting card with a quilled balloon-and-bear motif, and a quilled sunflower in a white shadow-box frame. These are three distinct products that need their own individual product photos before being catalogued.

A handmade Valentine's card featuring a quilled red heart with intricate spiral filigree on one side and smooth layered loops on the other. Topped with a 'Happy Valentine's Day' label. Comes with a coordinating red envelope. Internal wording can be customised on request.

Inventory/component shot showing four loose mini quilled hearts beside a Valentine's title card. Likely a behind-the-scenes photo rather than a finished product. Recommend dropping unless reused as 'about my process' content.

A handmade card featuring a heart-shaped wreath built from delicate red leaves and tiny white quilled accents. A more botanical, romantic take on the classic Valentine's heart. Topped with a 'Happy Valentine's Day' label. Comes with a coordinating envelope. Internal wording can be customised on request.

A handmade card featuring a quilled pink-and-white heart formed from elegant curved swirls meeting at a single point. Mounted on a deckle-edged white panel against a deep red background. Topped with a 'Happy Valentine's Day' label and coordinating envelope. Internal wording can be customised on request.

A handmade card featuring a quilled teddy bear in pink and rose tones holding a small red heart-shaped balloon on a thin string. Topped with a 'Love' label. A sweet, gentle alternative to the classic heart cards - works for Valentine's, anniversaries, or 'just because'. Internal wording can be customised on request.

A handmade card featuring a quilled heart densely filled with tightly rolled red and burgundy spirals - the most maximalist heart design in the collection. Topped with a 'Happy Valentine's Day' label and coordinating envelope. Internal wording can be customised on request.

A handmade card featuring three sprigs of quilled purple lavender with green stems, gathered with a small twine bow. Shown here as a 'Get Well Soon' card, but the lavender motif works equally well for sympathy, thinking-of-you, or thank-you cards. Internal wording and labelled occasion can be customised on request.

A handmade 'Congratulations, It's a boy' card featuring a pair of quilled baby footprints in soft blues with tiny rolled toes. Layered blue and white panels create a calm, considered nursery-themed design. Comes with a coordinating blue envelope. Pairs with the matching 'It's a girl' card.

A handmade 'Congratulations, It's a girl' card featuring a pair of quilled baby footprints in soft pinks with tiny rolled toes. Layered pink and white panels create a calm, considered nursery-themed design. Comes with a coordinating pink envelope. Pairs with the matching 'It's a boy' card.

An elegant framed quilling of a sitting cat in profile, rendered entirely in black paper with intricate filigree scrollwork forming the body, tail and decorative interior detail. Mounted in a light oak shadow-box frame against a clean white background - a striking, contemporary piece equally at home in a modern hallway or a quiet reading nook.

A single quilled sunflower with layered yellow and orange petals, a dense dark-brown spiral centre, and swirling green leaves and tendrils filling the surrounding space. Mounted in a white shadow-box frame. A cheerful, warm piece suited to kitchens, dining rooms or bright living spaces.

A vibrant tree of life with a black silhouette trunk and visible roots, crowned with hundreds of tightly rolled quilled leaves in every colour of the rainbow. A celebration piece often given to mark new beginnings, weddings, milestone birthdays or family gatherings. Available framed in light oak, white, or black - or unframed - by request. Also available in an autumn palette (warm oranges, browns and dark greens) — see additional photos.
Close-up showing the dimensional quilled leaves standing proud of the surface.
Same artwork in a white frame.
Same artwork in a black frame.

Autumn palette variant: tree of life with warm oranges, deep browns, and dark greens replacing the rainbow leaves — same composition, completely different mood. Light oak frame, front-on canonical product shot.
Autumn palette variant photographed at a side angle — emphasises the dimensional rolled-paper construction of each leaf.

A serene quilled sailboat with cream and teal swirled sails, a layered brown hull, and graceful blue-and-white waves beneath. Mounted in a clean white square shadow-box frame. Part of an optional nautical trio (with the lighthouse and anchor) - perfect for coastal homes, beach houses, or seaside-themed nurseries.
Close-up of the sailboat showing the layered paper edges and swirled detail in the sails.
Sailboat photographed from a slight angle showing the three-dimensional depth of the piece.
Side-angle shot in a rope-edged frame variant.

A charming quilled lighthouse with a blue-and-white striped tower, a yellow beacon casting horizontal light rays, and swirling deep-blue waves crashing at its base. Mounted in a light oak shadow-box frame edged with rope detail. Part of an optional nautical trio (with the sailboat and anchor) - well suited to coastal homes and children's rooms with a seaside theme.
Wide shot of the lighthouse showing the rope-edged frame.
Side-angle close-up showing the depth of the wave detail at the base.

A cheerful quilled whale in deep navy and teal with elegant scrollwork detail across its body, spouting twin curls of water from its blowhole. Mounted in a rope-edged white shadow-box frame. Often paired with the personalised initial frame (see Custom Initial pieces) for nursery wall sets.

A personalised statement letter rendered in dark blue and silver-grey quilled scrollwork, with small accent pieces (starfish, shell) tucked into the lower corner. Each piece is made to order for a chosen initial - the example shown features a 'J'. A favourite for nautical-themed nurseries, often commissioned alongside the matching whale piece. Please specify the desired letter when enquiring.
Side-by-side display showing the initial alongside the matching whale piece - frequently commissioned as a pair.

Studio composite showing the full nautical trio (anchor, sailboat, lighthouse) displayed together on a shelf. Useful as a 'set' marketing shot but not a saleable individual product. Recommend keeping as a homepage/lifestyle hero image rather than a gallery entry - or use as the main image for a future 'Nautical Trio' set product if you'd prefer to sell the three together.

A made-to-order children's name piece featuring a soft, sleepy-eyed fox in oranges and creams with delicate quilled flourishes on the tail, paired with the child's name in textured navy-and-teal quilled lettering. The example shown features the name 'Hunter'. A popular nursery and first-birthday commission - please specify the name, preferred fox palette, and lettering colour when enquiring.

A striking framed quilling of a beetle with iridescent green-and-bronze striped wing cases, a dense filigree thorax in greens and golds, and bold black legs spreading naturalistically across the white background. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. An unusual, scientific-illustration-meets-folk-art piece for studies, libraries or anywhere an entomological accent is welcome.

A made-to-order personalised name piece featuring crisp white block letters set against a lavish background of pink quilled flowers, swirling filigree, tulips and leaves. The example shown features the name 'Heidi'. Each piece is built up by hand over many hours of layered quilling work - see the process photos in this listing for a glimpse of how it comes together. A favourite for nursery walls, milestone birthdays and personalised wedding or anniversary gifts. Please specify the name, preferred palette, and any flower or motif preferences when enquiring.
The finished piece photographed unframed, showing the full density of the floral quilling work and the dimensional layering.
Process shot: the first letter H placed on the backing board, with faint pencil marks indicating where the remaining letters and dots will go.
Process shot: all five letters laid out and positioned, ready for the decorative quilling work to begin around them.
Process shot: the first decorative elements begin to take shape - pink swirls, a daisy with leaf, a heart inside the 'e', and quilled flourishes behind the 'd'.
Process shot: larger flowers and green sprigs added, building up the floral garden that frames the name.
Process shot: dense pink and cream filigree fills the background between the letters, with stylised daisies and tightly rolled accent pieces nearly complete.

A made-to-order personalised initial piece featuring a single tall white block letter set against a lavish background of pink quilled florals, hearts, swirling filigree and rolled roses. A small subtitle reads '...is for [Name]' running vertically beside the letter. The example shown features 'I is for Indiana'. A favourite for nursery walls, christenings, and first-birthday commissions. Please specify the initial letter, the full first name for the subtitle, and any palette preferences when enquiring.
Styled shot showing the finished piece displayed on a shelf alongside a vase of dried eucalyptus - useful for buyers picturing the piece in a home setting.
Top-down side angle showing the dimensional depth of the quilled paper rising off the backing board.
Side-angle close-up of the right half of the piece, showing the heart cutout detail and the layered rolled roses.

A handmade Mother's Day card featuring three small quilled flowers (pink, peach, and yellow-and-green) set into individual square windows cut into the card front, with a 'Happy Mother's Day' header and a 'Love Ya' tag at the lower corner. A floral patterned spine runs down the left edge. Comes with a coordinating envelope. Internal wording can be customised on request.

A handmade Mother's Day card featuring an elegant single-line black quilled silhouette of a mother cradling her baby, with a rose-gold-framed 'Happy 1st Mother's Day' label below. A striking, minimalist alternative to the floral Mother's Day options. Internal wording and the labelled occasion (e.g. 'Happy Mother's Day' instead of '1st') can be customised on request.
Side angle showing the dimensional depth of the quilled silhouette and the rose-gold foil detailing on the label.

A handmade Mother's Day card featuring three sprigs of quilled wisteria — one purple, flanked by two pink — with green leaves and a small butterfly bow at the base. Set on a soft lavender oval background with a 'Happy Mother's Day' banner below. Comes with a coordinating envelope. A close cousin of the all-purple Lavender Bouquet card (see P024); internal wording can be customised on request.

suggested_title: Pink Elephant with Balloons (Framed Nursery Art)
description: A cheerful framed quilling of a baby elephant with grey body, soft pink ear interiors, a pink bow atop her head, and a cluster of five pink balloons held by hand-drawn strings tied to her tail. The trunk lifts joyfully upward. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. A favourite for baby-girl nurseries; a blue/boy palette variant is available on request — please specify when enquiring.
Top-down side angle showing the dimensional rolled-paper construction of the body and balloons.
Lifestyle shot of the framed elephant displayed on a shelf between two woven rattan daisies — useful for showing scale and styling context.

suggested_title: Brown Monkey with Balloons (Framed Nursery Art)
description: A cheerful framed quilling of a baby monkey with a brown body, cream face and ear interiors with pink centres, pink-heart paw pads, a pink bow on the tail, and a cluster of four pink balloons floating above. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. Pairs naturally with the Pink Elephant piece (P042) for a coordinated nursery wall. A blue/boy palette variant is available on request — please specify when enquiring.
Top-down side angle showing the rolled-paper depth of the monkey's body and the layered cream-and-pink face detail.
Closer side angle showing the face and balloon-string detail from a different perspective.

Lifestyle shot of the framed monkey displayed on a shelf alongside woven rattan daisies — matches the styling of the elephant lifestyle shot (image in P042) and the two products are commonly photographed and sold as a coordinated nursery pair.

suggested_title: Pink Panda with Balloons (Framed Nursery Art)
description: A cheerful framed quilling of a baby panda with the classic black-and-white pattern, soft pink ear interiors and cheek-blush spirals, a pink bow atop the head, a pink pompom tail accent, and a cluster of three pink balloons held by hand-drawn strings. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. The third piece in the Nursery Animals with Balloons series — pairs with the Pink Elephant (P042) and Brown Monkey (P043) to form a coordinated trio. A blue/boy palette variant is available on request — please specify when enquiring.
Top-down side angle showing the dimensional depth of the panda's rolled-paper body and the layered ear and balloon construction.
Closer side angle showing the face, pink bow, and cheek-blush detail.
Lifestyle shot of the framed panda displayed on a shelf alongside woven rattan daisies — matches the styling of the elephant (P042) and monkey (P043) lifestyle shots.

Studio composite showing the full Nursery Animals trio (elephant, panda, monkey) displayed together on a shelf. Useful as a homepage/lifestyle hero image or as the main shot for a future 'Nursery Animals Trio' set product — not a saleable individual entry. Same treatment as the nautical trio composite (P034). Note: 481145971 is a near-duplicate of this composite shot.
Second composite/hero shot of the Nursery Animals trio — near-duplicate of 480429958, slightly different framing/positioning. Keep one and drop the other.

A beautifully detailed quilled cockatiel with the characteristic yellow head and crest, a vivid orange cheek patch, a soft pink beak, and a layered grey-and-charcoal body with scalloped wing detail. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. Available in white, light oak, or black frame — please specify when ordering. A natural companion piece to the cockatoo and other Australian-native bird studies in the framed birds collection.
Same artwork shown in a light oak frame variant — illustrates the frame-option flexibility.
Close-up macro showing the yellow head detail, orange cheek patch, and the dimensional rolled-paper scalloping of the wing feathers.
Side angle of the cockatiel in a white shadow-box frame — shows the dimensional construction of the body, tail, and pink feet.

suggested_title: Kangaroo with Balloons (Framed Nursery Art - Blue Palette)
description: A cheerful framed quilling of a baby kangaroo with a soft brown-grey body, tall pink-lined ears, pink cheek-blush spirals, a black nose and whiskers, a blue bow tie, and a cluster of four blue-and-white balloons held by hand-drawn strings. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. The first proven blue/boy-palette entry in the Nursery Animals with Balloons series. A pink/girl palette variant or a different animal in this blue palette is available on request — please specify when enquiring.
Top-down side angle showing the dimensional depth of the kangaroo and the layered balloon construction.
Lifestyle shot of the framed kangaroo displayed alongside a soft blue teddy bear — shows scale and the boy-nursery styling context.

A large-scale abstract framed quilling in a soft sea-glass palette — layered ribbons of sage, eucalyptus, cream and dusty teal curl and overlap to create a flowing, calligraphic composition with substantial dimensional depth. Mounted in a clean light oak frame. A statement piece for a hallway, lounge, or above a console table — distinctly different in mood from the figurative and themed work in the rest of the collection.
Closer side angle showing the depth and the layered ribbon construction.
Staged interior shot showing the piece hanging above a wooden console table in a panelled hallway — useful for buyers visualising scale and styling context.

A small quilled mandala flower mounted on a miniature stretched canvas, displayed on its own little wooden easel — a compact, giftable piece for desks, shelves, or small wall arrangements. The example shown features a radial sunflower-style mandala in yellow and orange petals with a red centre and small blue accent dots. Each canvas is made by hand and the palette can be customised on request — see the alternative palette in the additional image. Comes with the wooden easel.
The same mandala canvas concept in an alternative pink, green and purple palette — illustrates the colour flexibility for bespoke orders.

A small quilled rainbow arched between two soft white clouds with six tiny pastel hearts (yellow, pink, blue, mint, peach, lilac) scattered around it, mounted on a miniature stretched canvas displayed on its own little wooden easel. A gentle, gift-scale piece well suited to children's rooms, baby shower gifts, or a soft accent on a bedside table. Comes with the wooden easel.

A striking framed quilling of an electric guitar in fiery reds, oranges, and yellows with deep black accents and intricate spiral filigree throughout the body. Hand-drawn musical notes float on a flowing staff from the headstock outward. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. A bold, gift-led piece for a musician, a music room, or a teenager's bedroom. Also available in a monochrome (black, white and grey) palette and in a black frame — see additional photos for palette and frame variants.
Alternative front-on shot of the warm-fire palette guitar in a white frame — slightly different framing/mat from the canonical main shot.
Dramatic side angle of the warm-fire palette guitar in a white frame, foregrounding the dimensional spiral filigree in the guitar body.
Another side angle of the warm-fire palette guitar in a white frame — shows the rolled-paper construction of the body curves.

Palette + frame variant: the same guitar design in a monochrome (black, white, and grey) palette, mounted in a black shadow-box frame. Confirms the monochrome/black-frame combination as a documented variant alongside the warm-fire/white-frame version.
Monochrome palette in black frame, photographed from a side angle showing the dimensional spirals.
Monochrome palette in black frame, dramatic side angle showing the depth of the rolled-paper construction.

A three-aperture white shadow-box frame spelling out the message 'Give Yourself Time', with each word paired with a stage of butterfly metamorphosis: 'Give' with a striped monarch caterpillar on grass, 'Yourself' with a hanging green-and-gold chrysalis on a leafy branch, and 'Time' with the fully-emerged orange-and-black monarch butterfly. A gentle, meditative inspirational piece for offices, healing spaces, study walls, or anywhere a quiet reminder of patience and growth would be welcome.
Earlier in-progress photograph showing the first two frames ('Give' and 'Yourself') of the triptych before the 'Time' frame was completed. Useful as a process/behind-the-scenes shot.
Close-up macro of the third frame: the orange-and-black monarch butterfly with the 'Time' label above — shows the dimensional spiral construction of the wings.

A botanical-illustration-style framed quilling of three blossoms of the Australian native Corymbia ficifolia (red flowering gum) — vivid pink fringed flowers with golden-yellow stamens, hanging from a brown stem with three sage-green eucalyptus leaves. Includes a scientific name plaque. Part of the same natural-history-specimen aesthetic family as the Blue Banded Bee (P014) and the Framed Beetle (P036) — suited to studies, libraries, or anywhere an Australian native botanical accent is welcome. NOTE: the scientific name label currently reads 'Corumbia' (typo) — should be 'Corymbia'. Worth correcting before this listing goes live.

A series of small framed quillings, each showing a single stylised vase with two delicate paper flowers and curling green tendrils. Available in multiple flower colours: blue, magenta/purple, red, and yellow (see additional photos). Each is mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame; vases are deliberately rendered as flat white silhouettes so the dimensional quilled blooms above sit forward as the focal point. Sold individually or as a coordinated set of two or four. Please specify your preferred colour(s) when ordering.
Blue palette variant: two blue daisy-style blooms with green tendrils above the white silhouette vase.
Magenta/purple palette variant: two bright magenta blooms with green tendrils.
Red palette variant: two deep red blooms with curling green tendrils.
Yellow palette variant: two bright yellow daisies with green tendrils.

A vibrant quilled butterfly with rainbow-coloured wings (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) and a dimensional white body, mounted on a miniature stretched canvas. Each wing features dense rolled-paper spirals of varying sizes. A cheerful gift-scale piece for desks, shelves, kitchens, or children's spaces. Comes with a small wooden easel. Part of the mini-canvas series alongside the Mandala (P048), Rainbow & Hearts (P049), Rainbow Garden (P055), Sunflower (P059), and Ladybug Vine (P067) designs.

A whimsical quilled garden scene with six tightly-rolled flower blossoms in rainbow colours (yellow, blue, pink, red, orange, purple) on slender green stems, surrounded by curving green grass blades and a single small quilled butterfly hovering above. Mounted on a miniature stretched canvas with a wooden easel. A bright, joyful piece for desks, kitchens, garden-themed rooms, or children's spaces.

A charming minimalist framed quilling of two cats — one white, one black — sitting side by side with their tails curving upward and meeting to form a heart shape above them. Each cat's body is constructed from tightly nested paper spirals, with delicate whisker detailing on each face. A sentimental piece for cat lovers, couples, anniversaries, or 'just because' gifts. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame.
Alternative front-on flat shot of the two-cats piece in a white shadow-box frame — slightly different framing/lighting from the canonical main shot.
Side-angle close-up showing the dimensional rolled-paper construction of each cat's body and the curving black tail that forms the heart.
Dramatic close-up side angle from the upper-left, foregrounding the heart and the depth of the spiral filigree in both cats.

A second large-scale abstract framed quilling in the sea-glass palette — sage, eucalyptus, dusty teal, and cream ribbons curl and overlap in a denser, more wave-like composition than the calligraphic sea-glass piece (P047). Mounted in a clean light oak frame. Pairs naturally with P047 as a coordinated pair, or stands alone as a statement piece. A more aquatic, ocean-inspired reading than the freer calligraphic sister piece.

A single fern frond rendered in quilled paper with leaflets graduating through the full rainbow spectrum — deep red at the base, climbing through orange, yellow, green, blue, purple and pink to white at the tip. A delicate, contemplative piece with a botanical-specimen feel. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. Pairs naturally with the Rainbow Tree of Life (P029) for buyers wanting a coordinated set in the rainbow palette family.
Side-angle close-up showing the dimensional layering of each leaflet rising off the backing board and the delicate white central stem.
Oblique macro side angle showing the upward-curving tip of the frond and the depth of the rolled-paper construction in each leaflet.

A single dense quilled sunflower with layered yellow petals and a dimensional brown centre, surrounded by curling green tendrils, mounted on a miniature stretched canvas displayed on its own little wooden easel. A cheerful, gift-scale piece for desks, kitchens, or small wall arrangements. Comes with the wooden easel. Part of the mini-canvas series alongside the Mandala (P048), Rainbow & Hearts (P049), Butterfly (P054), Rainbow Garden (P055), and Ladybug Vine (P067) designs.

A striking framed quilling of a dog or cat paw print rendered entirely in black: one large rounded triangular pad and four oval toe pads, each filled with intricate spiral filigree and small flower-motif detailing. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. A meaningful gift for pet owners, dog/cat lovers, or as a memorial piece for a beloved pet. Available in white frame (shown here) or black frame (see additional photo) — please specify when ordering. A rainbow-coloured paw-print version in a heart frame is also available (see P066).
Frame variant: the same paw print design in a black shadow-box frame, front-on canonical shot.
Side-angle close-up of the paw print (black frame variant edge visible at right), foregrounding the spiral filigree work in the pads.
Tighter oblique angle of the paw print in a white frame, emphasising the dimensional rolled-paper construction.

A magical quilled unicorn portrait featuring a white head and body in profile, a tightly-spiralled white horn, and a flowing pastel rainbow mane in dimensional ribbon-style quilling (purple, pink, green, orange, blue). Surrounded by small floating pastel hearts in yellow, pink, purple, blue, and green. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame with a light oak outer frame. A favourite for girls' bedrooms, nurseries, milestone birthdays, and first-communion gifts. The first mythological-creature piece in the catalog — palette can be customised on request.
Side-angle close-up showing the dimensional ribbon construction of the rainbow mane and the floating pastel hearts.

A large landscape-oriented framed quilling spelling 'HOME' in ornate dimensional capitals. Each letter is constructed from layered quilled spirals in a cream, ivory, charcoal and dark brown palette, with delicate floral and curling-tendril accents woven through and around the letters. Mounted on a clean white background with a deep chocolate-brown wooden outer frame and cream inner mat. A welcoming statement piece for hallways, entry walls, or above a sideboard; works as a housewarming, engagement, or new-home gift.
Side-angle macro of the 'M' and 'E' end of the word, foregrounding the dimensional spiral construction and the floral filigree decoration around each letter.

suggested_title: I Love Ewe — Valentine's / Anniversary Card
description: A handmade A6 greeting card featuring a charming quilled sheep with a black head and white spiral-wool body, standing in a small patch of grass, with three small red quilled hearts floating overhead. The 'I love ewe' caption — a gentle sheep-themed pun — sits below the design. A sweet, slightly cheeky alternative to a traditional Valentine's or anniversary card. Comes with a matching envelope. Blank inside for your own message.

suggested_title: Make Your Own Luck — Shamrock Frame
description: A small framed quilling featuring three dimensional green shamrocks (one large four-leaf clover and two smaller three-leaf clovers) growing from a tuft of green quilled grass, with the printed caption 'make your own LUCK' on a small card below. A motivational St Patrick's Day or Irish-themed gift suited to desks, shelves, or small wall arrangements; reads year-round as a 'good fortune' piece rather than strictly seasonal. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame.
Side-angle close-up showing the dimensional rolled-paper construction of each shamrock — the heart-shaped leaflets and central spirals are visible in this view.
Lifestyle shot of the framed piece styled on a console alongside two ceramic vases and a sprig of dried eucalyptus — useful for buyers visualising the piece in a home setting.

A handmade A6 Christmas card featuring an elegant six-pointed quilled snowflake in cream and ivory tones, mounted on a clean white card with the printed greeting 'Merry Christmas' above. A timeless, understated holiday card suitable for any recipient. Comes with a matching envelope. Blank inside for your own message. Available individually or as a set — please specify quantity when ordering.

suggested_title: Rainbow Paw Print in Heart Frame
description: A heart-warming framed quilling featuring a paw print rendered in vibrant rainbow colours (pink, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) nested inside an outline heart constructed from delicate white quilled filigree. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. A bright, celebratory gift for pet owners, rainbow-bridge memorial pieces, or simply for someone whose pet is the centre of their world. Distinct from the all-black quilled paw print (P060), which offers a more classic monochrome aesthetic.

A pair of vivid red quilled ladybugs perched on a curving green leaf-vine, mounted on a miniature stretched canvas displayed on its own little wooden easel. Each ladybug features dimensional spiral wing detail, black spots, and tiny antennae; the vine has eight rolled-paper leaves curling along its length. A cheerful, gift-scale piece for desks, kitchens, garden-themed rooms, or children's spaces. Comes with the wooden easel. Part of the mini-canvas series alongside the Mandala (P048), Rainbow & Hearts (P049), Butterfly (P054), Rainbow Garden (P055), and Sunflower (P059) designs.

A handmade A6 Christmas card featuring a quilled traditional Christmas stocking — a deep red stocking body filled with intricate spiral filigree and topped with a glittery white cuff. The printed greeting 'Merry Christmas' sits above the stocking, with iridescent glitter accents scattered across the white card background. A festive, classic holiday card. Comes with a matching envelope. Blank inside for your own message. Available individually or as a set — please specify quantity when ordering.

A delicate Christmas tree ornament: a clear plastic bauble containing a quilled pink-and-mauve six-pointed snowflake suspended inside, with a scattering of magenta glitter at the base of the bauble and a soft grey ribbon for hanging. The first 3D / hangable piece in the collection. A keepsake decoration that doubles as a quiet tribute to careful handmade work — beautiful catching the light on a tree branch or hanging in a window. Available in alternate colour palettes by request (please ask). Available in additional palette options including white-and-silver with matching glitter.

suggested_title: Personalised Baby Birth Announcement (Sample: Halli Ash)
description: A made-to-order personalised birth announcement frame featuring a dimensional quilled teddy bear (palette to suit — this sample shown in pink, also available in blue, neutral, or your choice of colours), four floating balloons bearing the baby's birth statistics (length, weight, date, time of birth), and the baby's name spelled out in coordinating quilled letters on a small card below. A meaningful, keepsake gift for a baby shower, christening, naming day, or first birthday — designed to be displayed in the nursery for years. Please provide the baby's full name, date of birth, time of birth, weight, length, and any palette preferences when ordering. This piece is a commission example and is offered as a custom order only; please allow 3–4 weeks for completion.

A coordinated set of six handmade gift tags, each featuring a different quilled Christmas motif on a white tag with gold cord: a gold-and-red angel with halo, a red-and-green poinsettia, a red-and-white candy cane, a tall green Christmas tree, a trio of wrapped presents in red/white/green, and a top-hatted snowman. Ready to tie onto presents for a finished, handcrafted touch.

suggested_title: Merry Christmas — String of Lights Card
description: A handmade A6 Christmas card featuring a string of quilled Christmas lights — seven dimensional teardrop bulbs in yellow, green, red, pink, blue, orange and purple, each capped with a small grey base, strung along a green twisted-paper wire. Topped with a printed "Merry Christmas" greeting. Comes with a coordinating envelope.

A delicate Christmas tree ornament: a clear plastic bauble containing a quilled blue paw print (one large pad and four toe pads in dimensional blue spirals) suspended inside, with a scattering of blue glitter at the base of the bauble and a soft blue grosgrain ribbon hanger. A second 3D ornament in the homewares range alongside the snowflake bauble.

A handmade card featuring a charming quilled bumblebee with a yellow-and-black striped body, soft grey wings, and curling black antennae, accompanied by three tiny red quilled hearts in the upper-left corner. Captioned "Bee mine" in script. A playful, pun-driven alternative to a classic Valentine's card.

A botanical-illustration-style framed quilling of the Australian native Callistemon citrinus (crimson bottlebrush) — a stem of slender dark-green leaves bearing a dense cluster of vivid red bottlebrush blossoms with fringed centres. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame with a printed scientific-name label. Companion piece to P052 (Corymbia ficifolia) and P088 (Acacia pycnantha) in the native-botanicals series.

A minimalist handmade card with the word "Love" written in printed black calligraphy, the "o" replaced by a dimensional quilled red heart, pierced through by a printed black arrow that extends across the full width of the card. A clean, modern Valentine's or anniversary card. Comes with a coordinating envelope.

A made-to-order personalised name piece featuring crisp white block letters set against a vibrant rainbow background — each letter is filled with a riot of tightly-rolled paper spirals in every colour of the rainbow, with floral and heart accents tucked between the strokes. The example shown spells "Lucian" with a small heart dot above the "i". A long landscape white shadow-box frame. Custom orders made to the customer's chosen name; full-name version companion to P038 (single-initial floral) and P108 (single-initial filled).

A large framed quilling of the map of Australia, the continent and Tasmania filled with intricate filigree spirals in muted heritage tones — soft blues, dusty mauves, sandy creams, and pale greys with white accent coils — and a small quilled heart placed centrally over the inland. Mounted in a light oak shadow-box frame with a generous white mat. A statement piece for Australian-themed décor.
Work-in-progress: the cut-out continent outline before quilling is added.
Work-in-progress: the cut-out continent outline with Tasmania, ready to be filled.

A wide triptych shadow-box frame in light oak presenting three native Australian botanical quillings side by side, each with its printed scientific-name label: Corymbia ficifolia (flowering gum, pink-and-yellow blossoms), Acacia pycnantha (golden wattle, yellow pompom flowers on grey-green leaves), and Callistemon citrinus (crimson bottlebrush, dense red blossoms on green foliage). The individual pieces (P052, P088, P075) are also available separately.

A dimensional framed quilling of an Australian sulphur-crested cockatoo perched on a brown branch with green leaves — bright yellow crest fanned upward, soft white-and-pale-lavender body, dark beak, yellow underwing accents, and a long pale tail. Mounted in a light oak shadow-box frame. Part of the Australian birds series alongside the Kookaburra (P082) and Galah (P083).
Sold example, photographed in the oak frame.
Close-up perspective showing the dimensional crest and body feathers.

A dramatic art-style framed quilling of a yellow-tailed black cockatoo, head-on and brooding — the head a dense field of black filigree spirals, piercing yellow eyes, a heavy curved black beak, and a long fanned tail of mustard-yellow and black plumage. Mounted against a black background in a deep black shadow-box frame. A more graphic, stylised counterpart to the naturalistic P011 and P012.

A dimensional framed quilling of an Australian kookaburra perched on a brown branch — soft cream-and-lavender chest, brown-and-grey wing with blue accent feathers, the distinctive long dark beak, and an orange-and-cream-banded tail. Mounted in a light oak shadow-box frame with a generous white mat. Part of the Australian birds series alongside the Sulphur-crested Cockatoo (P080) and Galah (P083).
Sold example.

A dimensional framed quilling of an Australian galah perched on a brown branch with eucalyptus leaves — soft pink crest with rolled spiral detail, deep pink chest with horizontal feather banding, and grey wings and tail. Mounted in a light oak shadow-box frame. Part of the Australian birds series alongside the Sulphur-crested Cockatoo (P080) and Kookaburra (P082).
Sold example.

Composite shot showing all three Aussie birds (P080 Sulphur-crested, P082 Kookaburra, P083 Galah) as a coordinated trio. Strong sub-collection candidate.

suggested_title: "Love is in the Air" Heart Balloons Card
description: A handmade card featuring four quilled heart-shaped balloons in red and soft pink, two large and two small, with delicate hand-drawn string tails trailing downward. Captioned "Love is in the air" in flowing script. A romantic alternative to the classic Valentine's heart.

A wide landscape framed quilling featuring five small round owls in a colourful row — orange, blue, purple, green and pink — perched on a richly textured brown branch with curling green leaves at either end. Each owl has dimensional white-and-black eyes and a small triangular beak. Mounted in a clean white landscape shadow-box frame. A cheerful nursery or family-room piece.

suggested_title: "I love you" Red Tulip Bouquet Card
description: A handmade card featuring a quilled bouquet of nine red tulips on slender green stems, gathered together with a small pink quilled bow. Captioned "I love you" in elegant script. Coordinating envelope included.

A botanical-illustration-style framed quilling of the Australian national floral emblem Acacia pycnantha (golden wattle) — a sinuous stem with paired grey-green elongated leaves and clusters of fringed golden-yellow pompom flowers. Mounted in a white shadow-box frame with a printed scientific-name label. Companion piece to P052 (Corymbia ficifolia) and P075 (Callistemon citrinus) in the native-botanicals series.

suggested_title: Merry Christmas — White & Gold Angel Card
description: A handmade A6 Christmas card featuring an elegant quilled angel — gold filigree halo, soft cream-and-gold wings, and a flowing white-and-gold robe with rolled spiral detail — surrounded by a scattering of gold glitter dots on a clean white card. Topped with a printed "Merry Christmas" greeting. Comes with a coordinating envelope.

suggested_title: Merry Christmas — Cream & Gold Bauble Card
description: A handmade A6 Christmas card featuring a quilled Christmas bauble in soft cream and gold tones, with rolled spiral detail inside the round body, hanging from a delicate gold hand-drawn string and bow with curling tinsel-style flourishes either side. Topped with a printed "Merry Christmas" greeting. Comes with a coordinating envelope.

A vivid green four-leaf clover with intricate spiral filigree detail in each leaf — varying shades of green plus dark accent coils — mounted on a miniature stretched canvas displayed on its own little wooden easel. Part of the mini-canvas series. Lucky charm and St Patrick's Day favourite.

A single large dimensional quilled feather mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. The feather is built from densely packed gradient ribbons of paper that fan out from a central white spine. Available in palette variants: cool (navy/blue/teal/green/cream) and warm (deep burgundy/red/orange/peach/cream). A bold, painterly statement piece.

suggested_title: Merry Christmas — Blue & Gold Snowflake Card
description: A handmade A6 Christmas card featuring an elaborate eight-pointed quilled snowflake in deep blue and gold, built from layered teardrop loops, tight spirals and starburst points. Surrounded by a scattering of blue glitter dots on a clean white card. Topped with a printed "Merry Christmas" greeting. Comes with a coordinating envelope.

suggested_title: Merry Christmas — Pink & Coral Snowflake Card
description: A handmade A6 Christmas card featuring an elaborate quilled snowflake in deep pink and copper-coral tones, built from layered teardrop petals, rolled spirals and slender star points. Set on a clean white card. Topped with a printed "Merry Christmas" greeting. Comes with a coordinating envelope.

suggested_title: Merry Christmas — Purple & Gold Snowflake Card
description: A handmade A6 Christmas card featuring a quilled snowflake in soft mauve and gold tones, built from a central four-petal flourish surrounded by rolled spiral coils and slender star points. Set on a clean white card. Topped with a printed "Merry Christmas" greeting. Comes with a coordinating envelope.

A whimsical quilled garden scene with eight tightly-rolled flower blossoms in rainbow colours (green spiral, purple, pink heart-flower, mustard, red spiral, red poppies, pink, green spiral) on slender green stems, joined by a small yellow butterfly. Surrounded by curving green grass blades and mounted on a miniature stretched canvas. A more populated companion variant to P055 (Mini Rainbow Garden Canvas) in the mini-canvas series.

A handmade card featuring a playful tic-tac-toe grid where three red quilled hearts (two large, one small) form a winning row diagonally across the board against three printed black X's. Captioned "You won my heart" in hand-lettered script below. A clever, witty alternative to the classic Valentine's card.
Composite shot showing Dolphin (P099), Whale (probably P032), and Seahorse (P100) side by side in matching rope-edged frames. Decide keep/drop/repurpose.

A cheerful quilled dolphin leaping upward, rendered in soft blues, teals and silver-greys with elegant scrollwork detail across the body and tail. Three small splash droplets float to the right. Mounted in a rope-edged white shadow-box frame. Part of the nautical series alongside P030 (Sailboat), P031 (Lighthouse), P032 (Whale) and P100 (Seahorse).

A graceful quilled seahorse with intricate scrollwork body — layered blues and teals with green eye highlights — accompanied by three teal bubble dots in the upper-left corner and a pair of slender green seaweed fronds at the base. Mounted in a rope-edged white shadow-box frame. Part of the nautical series alongside P030 (Sailboat), P031 (Lighthouse), P032 (Whale) and P099 (Dolphin).

A pair of quilled lovebirds — one buttery yellow on the left, one hot pink on the right — leaning toward each other with eyes closed and tiny red beaks almost touching, with a small two-tone heart floating between their heads. Each bird is built from elegant teardrop loops and rolled spirals. Mounted on a miniature stretched canvas. Part of the mini-canvas series.

suggested_title: Personalised Pet & Initial Frame (Sample: P + Black Labrador)
description: A made-to-order personalised piece featuring a quilled monogram letter — built from layered pink and charcoal spirals with floral and heart accents — paired with a dimensional silhouette of the customer's pet in dark felt. The example shown features the letter "P" beside a black labrador silhouette with a pink collar. Mounted in a light oak shadow-box frame. Available with any initial, palette and pet silhouette.

Composite shot showing Giraffe-with-Balloons (P103) and Lion-with-Balloons (P104) — two new pieces extending the nursery-animals-with-balloons series (P042-P046). Standalone main shots not yet supplied; create separate P103/P104 clusters when individual photos are available.

A handmade A6 Christmas card featuring a quilled cartoon reindeer — round brown spiral face, gold filigree antlers, dark brown ears with cream centres, googly eyes, and a bright red nose. Topped with a printed "Merry Christmas" greeting. A cheerful, whimsical card. Comes with a coordinating envelope.

A made-to-order personalised initial piece featuring a single tall block letter cut as an outline and filled with rolled-paper quilling in the customer's chosen palette — the example shown is a serif "L" filled with swirling blue, navy and pale lilac spirals with small floral accents. Mounted in a white square shadow-box frame. Single-initial sibling to the multi-letter Lucian style (P077); structurally distinct from P038 which sets a white letter against a quilled background.

suggested_title: Happy Valentine's Day — Tree of Hearts Card
description: A handmade square card featuring a delicate printed tree silhouette in charcoal with visible roots, its bare branches scattered with twelve dimensional quilled hearts in shades of pink, rose and deep red, alongside smaller printed pink hearts. Captioned "Happy Valentine's Day" beneath. Comes with a coordinating envelope.

A wide-eyed cartoon owl with dimensional brown and cream wavy-quilled body, large round eyes with black pupils, an orange beak, and curling spiral wing accents, perched on a small olive-coloured branch. Mounted on a miniature stretched canvas. Part of the mini-canvas series.

A classical yin-yang symbol rendered in dimensional quilling — one half built from black filigree spirals with a small lilac dot at its centre, the other from pale lilac and cream coils with a small black dot — meeting in flowing wave-like halves. Mounted in a deep black square shadow-box frame with a generous white mat. A calming, meditation-themed piece.

A miniature version of the yin-yang motif — black filigree on one side, pale-lilac filigree on the other, meeting in flowing waves with tiny contrast dots in each half. Mounted on a miniature stretched canvas displayed on its own little wooden easel. Part of the mini-canvas series; companion to the larger framed P111.

A pair of classic red-and-white-spotted toadstools (one large, one small) with cream stems, growing out of a tuft of dimensional green grass blades. Each cap is densely quilled with red on-edge paper banding and white spot accents. Mounted on a miniature stretched canvas. Part of the mini-canvas series.

Composite shot showing six mini-canvas pieces displayed together on wooden easels: P055 garden, P067 ladybugs, P091 clover, P101 lovebirds, P110 owl and P113 toadstools. Strong sub-collection candidate. Decide keep as series-hero / drop / repurpose.

A single large dimensional quilled butterfly with vivid azure-and-black wings, intricate spiral filigree across the wing surface, white accent dots scattered through both wings, and a heavy black body with curling antennae. Mounted in a clean white square shadow-box frame. A standalone framed butterfly distinct from the mini-canvas butterfly (P054) and the butterfly that appears in P051.

A black silhouette ballerina mid-pose with arms raised and one leg extended, her tutu rendered in dimensional quilled fans of pink, coral and peach spirals tied together at the waist with a small pink bow. Mounted in a clean white shadow-box frame. A graceful, feminine piece suitable for a girl's room or dance studio.

A heart-shaped composition built entirely from small dimensional quilled hearts — graduating from red at the top through orange, yellow, green, blue and purple at the point — packed densely so that the small hearts collectively form the larger heart silhouette. Mounted in a clean white square shadow-box frame. Closely related to P016 (rainbow heart of rolled coils); decide at consolidation whether to merge as a design variant.

A dimensional framed quilling of an Australian rainbow lorikeet perched on a brown branch — deep blue head with filigree spirals, lime-green chin band, vibrant green wings and tail, a wavy red-and-orange chest, and a bright red beak. Mounted in a light oak shadow-box frame. Part of the Australian birds series.

A dimensional framed quilling of an Australian magpie perched on a brown branch with green leaves — black body with white nape and back patches built from rolled spiral coils, a heavy silver-tipped black beak, and a single bright red eye. Mounted in a light oak shadow-box frame. Part of the Australian birds series.

A scientifically-styled framed quilled rendering of the Australian native stingless Sugarbag Bee (Tetragonula carbonaria), featuring a glossy black body with silver-thread filigree thorax detail, lacy translucent layered wings with intricate vein patterns, and the species name printed beneath the specimen on a clean white card. Mounted in a deep white shadow-box frame. Part of the native bees series alongside P014 (Blue Banded) and P121 (Domino Cuckoo); also available as a triptych (P122).

A scientifically-styled framed quilled rendering of the Australian native Domino Cuckoo Bee (Thyreus lugubris), featuring a striking black body covered in distinct white spot accents, fine quilled-filigree segmentation, slender outlined wings, and the species name printed beneath the specimen on a clean white card. Mounted in a deep white shadow-box frame. Part of the native bees series alongside P014 (Blue Banded) and P120 (Sugarbag); also available as a triptych (P122).

A wide triptych shadow-box frame in light oak presenting three native Australian bee quillings side by side, each with its printed scientific-name label: Sugarbag Bee (Tetragonula carbonaria), Blue Banded Bee (Amegilla cingulata), and Domino Cuckoo Bee (Thyreus lugubris). The individual pieces (P120, P014, P121) are also available separately.

A dimensional framed quilling of an Australian willie wagtail perched on a brown branch with green leaves — black body with a white belly and chin, the characteristic broad fanned black tail held high, and small bright spiral-detailed eye. Mounted in a light oak shadow-box frame. Part of the Australian birds series.

A scientifically-styled framed quilled rendering of the European Honey Bee (Apis mellifera), featuring a yellow-and-black banded abdomen with metallic gold thread detail, a glossy black thorax with gold filigree, layered cream-paper wings with intricate spiral vein patterns, and the species name printed beneath the specimen on a clean white card. Available in white-frame and black-frame options. Companion piece to the native bees series (P014, P120, P121, P122) covering the introduced honey bee.

A small framed quilling of a serene blue jellyfish — three rounded peaked-dome bell segments with deep navy spiral detail, long flowing teal and pale-mint tentacles trailing below, and a halo of small blue and green bubble dots surrounding the body. Mounted in a clean white standard shadow-box frame. Part of the mini sea-creatures sub-series alongside P126 (Seahorse) and P127 (Two Fish) — often sold as a coordinated trio.

A small framed quilling of a stylised blue seahorse with playful exterior spines, pale-mint and lime spiral filigree across the body, slender curling tail and dorsal-fin accents, with three small blue and mint bubble dots floating above. Mounted in a clean white standard shadow-box frame. Smaller, more cartoony companion to the larger nautical-series seahorse (P100); part of the mini sea-creatures sub-series alongside P125 (Jellyfish) and P127 (Two Fish).

A small framed quilling of two cheerful round fish swimming downward — each with a blue ring body packed with concentric blue and teal coil scales, a black eye dot, and pale-mint quilled tail fins — accompanied by a trail of small blue bubble dots and a pair of dimensional green seaweed fronds at the base. Mounted in a clean white standard shadow-box frame. Part of the mini sea-creatures sub-series alongside P125 (Jellyfish) and P126 (Seahorse).

Composite shot showing the mini sea-creatures trio together (P126 Seahorse, P127 Two Fish, P125 Jellyfish in matching small white frames). Strong sub-collection candidate, often sold as a coordinated trio. Decide keep as series-hero / drop / repurpose.

A graceful quilled angelfish with intricate scrollwork body — layered blues, teals and silver-greys with dimensional spirals across the fins and body — accompanied by a small school of teal bubble dots to the right. Mounted in a rope-edged white shadow-box frame. Part of the nautical series alongside P030 (Sailboat), P031 (Lighthouse), P032 (Whale), P099 (Dolphin), P100 (Seahorse) and P130 (Stingray).

A serene quilled stingray with a soft blue body patterned with dark blue dashes, dots and central swirl detail, a long curling tail, and a pair of slender green seaweed fronds at the base. Mounted in a rope-edged white shadow-box frame. Part of the nautical series alongside P030, P031, P032, P099, P100 and P129.
